item.description: Mark J. Rebilas-Imagn Images 49ers DE Nick Bosa’s own words foreshadow Week 9 injury return vs. Raiders appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The San Francisco 49ers are set to be without wide receiver Mike Evans for Week 9 against the Las Vegas Raiders. However, they are likely to get a key defensive star back in Nick Bosa . Per NFL insider Ian Rapoport, Bosa has been back on the training field and believes he is finally ready to return after a lengthy layoff. “Nick Bosa appears poised to return to the field for the first time since late September. Nick Bosa, dealing with a calf strain for about a month and a half. A little more for Nick Bosa. Calf strains are bad, they can linger. The 49ers know they are in it for the long haul. They wanted to make sure they take their time. But he has been on the field this week after the bye and told reporters in the locker room he believes he is good to go,” Rapoport said. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) A five-time Pro Bowler and one-time Defensive Player of the Year, Bosa is coming off a torn ACL that limited him to just three games last season. They are once again in Super Bowl contention and will hope to have all their stars healthy later in the season. Bosa will be tested in his first game back as he takes on a Raiders offense line that has done a fine job protecting quarterback Kirk Cousins. They have surrendered just 11 sacks thus far, which is tied for the fourth-fewest in the league. item.title: Tenth Circuit rules in favor of NCAA in Wisne eligibility lawsuit, overturns injunction
item.description: In a landmark legal win for the NCAA, the Tenth Circuit ruled in the governing body’s favor in the Wisne eligibility lawsuit on Friday. As a result, the injunction has been overturned as athletes sought a fifth year. The suit was filed in Colorado over the summer in light of the NCAA’s age-based, five-year eligibility model. Upon implementation, the new rule was not retroactive to members of the class of 2022, and a number of legal challenges followed. $19.99 gets you a FULL year of On3 | Rivals national coverage Judge Charlotte Sweeney of the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Colorado ruled in favor of the class by granting a nationwide injunction. In September, though, the Tenth Circuit granted the NCAA’s request for a stay of the injunction, which meant it was on pause pending a ruling from the court. Attorneys for both the plaintiffs and the NCAA argued before the three-judge panel Oct. 13. During oral arguments, the judges said one of the central parts of the case was figuring out how the athletes would be harmed if they were not declared eligible. SUBSCRIBE to the On3 NIL and Sports Business Newsletter “It doesn’t seem there’s been a definition of the market from a huge, huge division – golf, everything,” U.S. Circuit Judge Paul Kelly said during the hearing, via the AP . “And you’re lumping them all together and you never looked at commonality and interchangeability of the various buyers.” While the court stayed the Wisne injunction, more lawsuits were filed at the state level. The NCAA won out in some of those cases, including in Kentucky, Arizona and Ohio. As a result, athletes in those cases would not be eligible pending a final ruling. The Kentucky case notably includes Thomas Castellanos , who played four games for the Red Raiders after securing a preliminary injunction. However, after the Kentucky Court of Appeals dissolved the temporary injunction, his availability came into question while awaiting a hearing. A judge then granted a motion for a new injunction , and Castellanos suited up for Texas Tech vs. Arizona State . The NCAA announced implementation of its five-year, age-based eligibility model this summer. Athletes will now get five years to play five seasons, with their eligibility “clock” starting at their 19th birthday or the date they enroll at a university, whichever happens first. The Tenth Circuit’s ruling also comes as the Protect College Sports Act heads to the U.S. House of Representatives. It advanced out of the Senate by a 77-22 margin in late September and addresses eligibility, among many other issues. The House is not due back in session until after the midterm elections.

item.title: Patriots’ TreVeyon Henderson reveals hospitalization after mystery medical emergency
item.description: FOXBOROUGH, MASSACHUSETTS - NOVEMBER 02: TreVeyon Henderson #32 of the New England Patriots looks on from the sideline during the NFL 2025 game between Atlanta Falcons and New England Patriots at Gillette Stadium on November 02, 2025 in Foxborough, Massachusetts. (Photo by Maddie Meyer/Getty Images) Maddie Meyer New England Patriots running back TreVeyon Henderson , who has not played since Oct. 22 , says he was recently hospitalized for several days after experiencing an unexpected medical emergency involving unexplained neurological symptoms. Henderson addressed his condition in a statement shared on Friday, saying he underwent extensive medical testing and evaluation while in the hospital. “While the results of my comprehensive medical testing have come back positive and reassuring, the cause of this remains unknown and unexplainable,” Henderson said. Henderson said the symptoms have affected his strength, coordination, and some physical functions. He plans to continue working with specialists and physical therapists as he focuses on his recovery. “I am committed to doing everything necessary to return to full health,” Henderson said. “My health and long-term well-being remain my foremost priorities.” 🙏🏽 pic.twitter.com/l52XuixPOc — TreVeyon Henderson (@TreVeyonH4) November 6, 2026 Henderson also thanked his wife, family and loved ones, the New England Patriots organization, his agent, medical team and teammates for their support. He also leaned on his faith, referencing Romans 8:28, and thanked those who have offered prayers and encouragement during his recovery. Henderson and his wife are asking for continued prayers and privacy. “We respectfully ask for continued prayers and privacy as we focus on my health and recovery,” Henderson said. Henderson did not provide a timeline for a return. He didn’t play in Week 8 against the Miami Dolphins and has been ruled out for Week 9’s game against the Green Bay Packers. item.title: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson Suffers Mysterious Medical Emergency
item.description: New England Patriots running back TreVeyon Henderson has shared a deeply personal statement regarding a frightening medical situation that recently left him hospitalized for several days. The 24-year-old former Ohio State standout revealed that he experienced an unexpected medical emergency involving unexplained neurological symptoms. Although extensive testing reportedly produced reassuring results, Henderson said doctors have not yet determined what caused the episode. Most importantly, Henderson made it clear that his health and recovery are now his top priorities. Oct 11, 2026; Foxborough, Massachusetts, USA; New England Patriots running back TreVeyon Henderson (32) runs the ball against Las Vegas Raiders defensive end Malcolm Koonce (51) during the second quarter at Gillette Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Bob DeChiara-Imagn Images Credit: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect (Reuters) TreVeyon Henderson Reveals Details of Medical Emergency In a statement shared publicly Friday, Henderson explained what he has been experiencing and the challenges that remain ahead. “Recently, I experienced an unexpected and unusual medical emergency involving a series of unexplained neurological symptoms that required hospitalization for several days. During that time, I underwent extensive medical testing and evaluation. While the results of my comprehensive medical testing have come back positive and reassuring, the cause of this remains unknown and unexplainable.” That is certainly concerning news for Henderson, his family, his teammates, and everyone who has followed his football career. While Henderson described the testing results as encouraging, he acknowledged that the symptoms have affected several of his physical abilities. “I will continue working closely with specialists and physical therapists to focus on my recovery, as these symptoms have affected my strength, coordination, and some of my physical functions. I am committed to doing everything necessary to return to full health. My health and long-term well-being remain my foremost priorities.” Henderson did not disclose a specific diagnosis or provide a timetable for returning to football. His statement makes clear that he is focused on working with his medical team and recovering rather than rushing back onto the field. Henderson Shares Powerful Message About His Faith Beyond discussing his medical condition, Henderson offered an emotional message about his family and the role his Christian faith has played during this difficult experience. He thanked his wife for supporting him throughout the ordeal and expressed gratitude for the strength he has found in his relationship with Jesus Christ. Henderson also referenced Romans 8:28, emphasizing his belief that God remains faithful even during life’s most difficult circumstances. “The purpose of trials in life is not to drive us away from God, but to only bring us closer. item.title: Dianna Russini Set to Return to Media: What We Know
item.description: Dianna Russini is poised to make a sports media comeback soon, Front Office Sports has confirmed, several months after resigning from The Athletic in the aftermath of Page Six publishing photos showing her with Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel at an adults-only Arizona resort in April. After ProFootballTalk first reported that Russini has told people around the NFL that she is expecting to return to the industry next week, several options have emerged for what comes next. Russini is expected to launch new content sponsored by gambling operators, sources said, adding that there have been talks with Jake Paul’s Betr platform as well as offshore sportsbook BetUS. One source said that Russini has also had talks with iHeart. FOS discovered a new X/Twitter page titled “Russini Report,” created in October, that only has three followers—Andres Vargas, a content creator and spokesperson for BetUS, and Crossing Lines, a show sponsored by BetUS featuring ex-Barstool personality Jeff Nadu and co-host Donnie Seymour. An additional video manager, named Natalie, also follows the page from a protected account. The “Russini Report” page indicates a show will air live on Wednesdays encompassing pro football news, injuries, and analysis. The page previously indicated the show would be “powered by BetUS,” but that language has since been edited out. Screen grab Basketball Hall of Famer Dennis Rodman is also an endorser of BetUS, which is headquartered in Costa Rica. On Wednesday, Page Six reported that Russini will be “headlining her own show” on a digital platform. “It’s been in the works for a while and she can’t wait to get back to what she loves,” a source told Page Six . Russini stopped responding to messages when presented with BetUS, Betr, and iHeart as places she has had talks with. Her agent, Matt Olson of CAA, referred FOS to the publicist Melissa Nathan, who declined to comment. Spokespeople for BetUS, Betr, and iHeart did not respond to requests for comment, nor did Vargas. Jon “Stugotz” Weiner, a host for iHeart and its subsidiary Fox Sports Radio, has previously said he would welcome the chance to collaborate with Russini again. Russini was a frequent guest on Weiner’s previous show, The Dan Le Batard Show With Stugotz , and also joined Weiner on his I Love Football show during Super Bowl week this past February. If Russini reaches a deal with iHeart, it is not expected to encompass Fox Sports Radio, one source said. Barstool Sports founder Dave Portnoy also previously said he would consider hiring Russini, but he told FOS this week that she is not going to work for Barstool now. Sources told FOS that Kalshi, Underdog, and FanDuel are not in the running to sponsor her content at this time. After Russini and Vrabel were photographed hugging and holding hands, the two issued statements saying that their relationship was platonic, not romantic. Russini resigned from the New York Times -owned Athletic about a week later, and Vrabel missed one day of the NFL

item.title: Did NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani just take shot at LeBron James despite 76ers beating Knicks twice already this season?
item.description: Did NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani just take shot at LeBron James despite 76ers beating Knicks twice already this season? appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Despite playing for the Philadelphia 76ers, who have already beaten the New York Knicks twice, LeBron James is reportedly living in the Big Apple, which might’ve been alluded to by NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani. As Mamdani’s conversation with CNN after the midterms was ending, Jake Tapper threw in a subtle shot at the Knicks, saying, “Just one note — the Sixers have beaten the Knicks twice this season,” before throwing it over to Anderson Cooper. The quick-witted Mamdani didn’t let that slide . The mayor promptly responded, “We’ve got the pied-à-terre [tax] coming anyway.” Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Jake Tapper: “The Sixers have beaten the Knicks twice this season.” Zohran Mamdani: “Well, the pied-à-terre tax is coming anyway.” pic.twitter.com/rlI18GUIRN — NBABase (@TheNBABase) November 6, 2026 Could that have been a sneaky jab at James? A pied-à-terre is a secondary living space, and an annual tax on them recently took effect on July 1, 2026. Is 76ers star LeBron James living in New York City? Bill Streicher-Imagn Images Before the season, James confirmed that “multiple residences” would be in use during his time with the Sixers. He reportedly has access to a Fanatics helicopter to transport him to Philly . LeBron’s twilight years in his NBA career are going to be with the 76ers. He signed a two-year contract with a player option during the offseason. He and the 76ers spoiled the Knicks’ Opening Night festivities. The Knicks were celebrating their championship, handing out rings to the players and raising the banner into the rafters at Madison Square Garden. LeBron and Co. came in and beat New York in the season opener. They beat them again just over a week later, this time in the City of Brotherly Love. James, 41, has taken a back-seat role with the 76ers. He is averaging a career-low 15.7 points per game through nine games but averages 7.4 rebounds and assists per game. The Sixers have a mix of young and veteran stars. Tyrese Maxey has started fast, averaging 28 points per game. VJ Edgecombe, Jaylen Brown—who also joined the team in the offseason—and Joel Embiid round out the starting five. item.title: Global Lacrosse Games roster breakdown: Canada women
item.description: Canada is consistently one of the top two nations in the world in women’s lacrosse, and has been for decades. This country has produced some of the greatest lacrosse players in history, like the legendary Dana Dobbie. We are bound to see more greatness from this squad that has a No. 1 ranking in mind to chase after. The roster Canada has put together for the Lexus Global Lacrosse Games is an exciting mixture of seasoned leaders and exploding stars. Let’s break it down. Field Players Erica Evans Annabel Child Jordan Dean Milana Zizakovic Kassidy Morris Aurora Cordingley Maggie Cuddy Nicole Perroni Megan Kinna Madalyn Baxter Kylea Dobson Goalies Kameron Halsall Alecia Nicholas One word to describe this roster is… Poised. This Canadian team is primed and prepped for a big tournament. They have battled to the very end against USA the last few times the rival nations have matched up in a Sixes Championship, and are likely itching to get over that hump. Players like Erica Evans , Megan Kinna, Nicole Perroni and Aurora Cordingley have played on these big stages in a Canadian uniform before. Evans brings a decade of familiarity alone, playing with the Canadian national team since 2015. Their experience from playing for Canada for many years will bring a level of poise and comfort to the Global Lacrosse Games that’s needed to thrive and win against the other top nations in the world. Biggest star: Erica Evans Evans is coming off a championship summer with the Maryland Charm and has been an international star since she won a gold medal with the U19 Canadian team. She started off a historic run by being named to that 2015 All-World Team and has since been an All-World selection in nearly every international event she has participated in – in all disciplines: field, Sixes and box. She is a strong lefty and dominant force in the middle of the field, sparking transition plays and coming up with big caused turnovers. Her offensive IQ is next-level; she executes two-player games seamlessly and constantly opens up scoring opportunities for herself and others. Evans will be the main all-around Canadian player to keep an eye on throughout each game. Breakout candidate: Kameron Halsall Halsall is the type of goalkeeper who can make or break the outcome of a game. She stands tall in the crease and is a strong-handed lefty who clears the ball quickly the moment she makes a save in order to provide scoring opportunities for her offense going the other way. She is one of the goalies who thrives in a Sixes setting due to substantial breakaway shot opportunities that result from the fast pace of games. Halsall’s patience to not bite on shooters’ fakes and her ability to make a last-second sprawling stop are two of her many game-altering abilities as Canada’s main keeper. They can win it all if… They avoid the penalty box. item.title: Premier League legends at odds over 'overrated' Bradley Barcola following $167 million move
item.description: Bradley Barcola joined Liverpool in the summer from Paris Saint-Germain -Credit:Carl Recine, Getty Images Glen Johnson has addressed comments from France FIFA World Cup winner Emmanuel Petit, suggesting Liverpool overpaid for 'overrated' £123 million ($166.6 million) summer acquisition Bradley Barcola. The former Reds defender has expressed confidence that the winger will find his form following a challenging beginning to his Anfield tenure. Barcola toiled in an unaccustomed striker's position on Wednesday as Liverpool's flawless UEFA Champions League league phase record ended with a 3-2 loss to Fenerbahçe in Istanbul. The France international had shone in his prior Champions League road fixture, delivering an impressive hat-trick during the 6-3 winat LASK. -Credit:Laurence Griffiths, Getty Images However, those strikes represent the sole goals Barcola has managed across his 13 outings for the Reds following his blockbuster transfer from European champions Paris Saint-Germain on August 31. Earlier this month, former Arsenal, Barcelona, and Chelsea midfielder Petit, who captured the World Cup with France in 1998, stated via the Liverpool Echo : "£120m? I would never put that price tag on the table. We all know that in France. "We know that he is a quality player, he could sometimes be great, but he doesn't have consistency during games. He was good most of the time with Paris because of the whole team behind him. I would probably have spent £60m or £70m, maximum. That's my opinion. It's becoming common now that English clubs are spending so much money on overrated players." However, Johnson, who registered 200 appearances for Liverpool with nine goals and 13 assists following his £17.5 million (around $29 million) transfer from Portsmouth in June 2009, considers Barcola "world-class" and argues he shouldn't be evaluated solely on his price tag. He said: "I don't think Barcola is overrated. I think he's world-class. I've been a fan of his for a long time. I think he's brilliant. To listen to the latest episode of 'All Out Soccer' - CLICK HERE "I think what Manu Petit is trying to say is that he wasn't worth that money. I think that's what he meant. There's no doubt about his talent, his ability and obviously fans have the right to think whether he's world class or not. That's up to them. "But I think what Manu was actually meaning was the fact that there's some other players who are really good that are going for half the money. "So I think he meant more of that, than actually being not as good as people say. Because that's two different things. You need the talent there to compete with each other. I was hoping Liverpool would sign him before. The financial stuff, that has nothing to do with us. We just want to see the best players at Liverpool and how they can get it done. "And the best players will play. And the ones that aren't playing have to improve. It can only be a good level of competition." With Barcola's French international teammate Hugo

item.title: VfB Stuttgart vs. Werder Bremen preview: Undav and Füllkrug in contrasting form ahead of Topspiel
item.description: VfB Stuttgart vs. Werder Bremen preview: Undav and Füllkrug in contrasting form ahead of Topspiel Deniz Undav's VfB Stuttgart will host Niclas Füllkrug's Werder Bremen in the marquee fixture of matchday 10. VfB Stuttgart The captain's goal drought contributed to Stuttgart's slow start to the season. Undav had found the net twice, but none of those goals came in the league as his poor form led him to miss out on Jürgen Klopp's squad nomination for the second time. Meanwhile, Ermedin Demirović has been their go-to guy this season, although he was unable to score in the defeat against Galatasaray, who had an unsuccessful attempt to sign the Bosnian striker in the summer. Stuttgart returned to winning ways in Bundesliga on matchday 8 after successive defeats. Team News The absence of Atakan Karazor and Angelo Stiller in midfield would cause selection issues for Hoeneß, although the former has a slight chance to recover from an injury that forced his early substitution against Galatasaray. Demirović and Undav started together against both Leverkusen and the Turkish champions, although Hoeneß preferred different playing systems. In goal, Dennis Seimen is expected to return in place of the experienced Fabian Bredlow. Werder Bremen After matching Rudi Völler's club record of scoring in seven successive Bundesliga games, Füllkrug earned a national team call-up by Klopp on Thursday. The 33-year-old leads the scoring chart in Bundesliga, and he already opened a five-goal lead over a certain Harry Kane. The nine goals from the former Torjägerkanone winner helped Werder Bremen to start the matchday in fifth place after having to fight relegation consistently in past seasons. Daniel Thioune’s troops are unbeaten in Bundesliga since starting the campaign with a 4-1 defeat to Freiburg. Team News Mitchell Weiser suffered another injury setback inside the first 15 minutes in last week's 2-0 win over TSG Hoffenheim, and he'll miss this one at the very least. Eren Dinkci, who scored the second goal after replacing him, is expected to start in the right wing. Head-to-head Werder Bremen are unbeaten in their last two trips to Stuttgart, although the Swabians did win 4-0 at Weserstadion last season. The last time a game between the two sides ended goalless was in February 2006. Predicted Lineups Click here to see our predicted Stuttgart vs. Werder Bremen lineups.

item.title: Orlando City legend Robin Jansson announces retirement
item.description: Orlando City legend Robin Jansson announces retirement By Jaime Uribarri TRANSFER TRACKER STATUS: Retirement Orlando City defender Robin Jansson has announced his retirement from professional soccer after the 2026 MLS season, ending a legendary eight-year career with the Lions. The 34-year-old center back joined Orlando in March 2019 from from AIK Fotboll in his native Sweden. He helped the club lift the first trophy of their MLS era, the 2022 US Open Cup , and reach the 2024 Eastern Conference Final. Jansson was named captain ahead of the 2024 season amid a historic run that saw him set club records for appearances (263), starts (256) and minutes played (23,050) across all competitions. He's the longest-tenured player in Orlando City history. "First, I want to say it's been a pleasure to wear this jersey and fight for this crest. When I signed here eight seasons ago, I didn't know I would be here for that long,” said Jansson. “Together, we set new standards and brought home the club's first trophy of the MLS era. I was proud and honored to be given the captain's armband along the way. I've really enjoyed it and have been doing what I love for so many years at the same club. I have been treated very well during my time here, and it has become a place I can call home and will always be connected to. "But now it's time to step aside and retire from the game I grew up loving and dreaming about." Jansson helped guide Orlando to their debut Audi MLS Cup Playoffs appearance in 2020, the first of seven straight postseason berths for the league's longest active streak. He was also a key member of the Lions side that reached the MLS is Back Tournament Final in 2020 and qualified for the Concacaf Champions Cup for the first time in 2023. The club will recognize and celebrate Jansson following Saturday's Decision Day regular-season finale vs. the New England Revolution at Inter.co Stadium (4 pm ET | Apple TV ). “Robin will always hold a special place in the history of this club, and for me personally, because he was the first player I signed for Orlando City,” said sporting director and general manager Ricardo Moreira. “From the moment he arrived, he embraced everything this club stands for and grew into one of the most important figures in our history. He is a club legend, not only because of his performances and accomplishments, but because of the person, leader and teammate he has been throughout his time here. "We love Robin and his family, and we wish them nothing but happiness and success in this next chapter of his life.” READ MORE: MLS Transfer Tracker

item.title: Packers Addition Makes Honest Admission About Position Change
item.description: GREEN BAY, WISCONSIN - OCTOBER 18: Laken Tomlinson #72 and Jordan Morgan #77 of the Green Bay Packers in action against the Dallas Cowboys at Lambeau Field on October 18, 2026 in Green Bay, Wisconsin. (Photo by Michael Reaves/Getty Images) Getty DETROIT, MICHIGAN - OCTOBER 25: Josh Jacobs #8 of the Green Bay Packers celebrates a touchdown against the Detroit Lions during the third quarter at Ford Field on October 25, 2026 in Detroit, Michigan. (Photo by Gregory Shamus/Getty Images) Getty The Green Bay Packers surprisingly started offensive lineman Laken Tomlinson at right guard in Week 8 despite having one start on that side of the offensive line in his 12-year NFL career. Tomlinson noted that the transition is going great, but it was a lot tougher last week given the short week and lack of practice time. “I mean, it’s definitely a challenge, especially last week,” admitted Tomlinson. Tomlinson started for the Packers at left guard in Week 7. So, he practiced on the left side leading up to the game. Green Bay Packers Guard Laken Tomlinson Opens Up on Changing Sides Getty Josh Jacobs #8 of the Green Bay Packers Because the Packers played on Thursday night in Week 8, the team did not have a legitimate practice. So, Tomlinson had to change sides without much work in team drills. Tomlinson noted that the flip side is that this week gives him extra time to prepare for staying on the right side. “This week, especially going into the long weekend, I had some extra time to kind of just like go over some stuff on my own,” said Tomlinson. “Work on my technique and just work on flipping things technique-wise, and having these two days of practice. So definitely a lot more comfortable now.” Tomlinson has 11,131 snaps at left guard in his NFL career. After his Week 8 start, he has 131 snaps at right guard. The Packers coaching staff noted that Tomlinson was playing so well that they could not bench him. However, with starter Aaron Banks back in the lineup, the team could not keep him on the left side. So, they started him at right guard. Packers Run Game Struggles Continue Tomlinson has done well in pass protection, but the run game has not been seeing the benefits of the offensive line changes. The Packers guard noted that the team needs to stick with the ground attack and not give up now. “It’s coming, man,” said Tomlinson. “You just got to have faith and keep chopping wood. There’s the old saying, just like keep chopping wood. And you know, keep feeding the ball, keep running the ball, and you’ll see it come. I promise.” It is fair that Tomlinson made his first start at right guard and Banks made his first start since Week 2. Meanwhile, Josh Jacobs has only played two games as the Packers’ running back. An improved and more consistent offensive line, combined with Jacobs feeling more comfortable behind the line, could lead to an improved rushing attack. The results have not shown yet, but there is reason to have hope towards the end of the season. The Pack

item.title: TIME MACHINE: GENOA vs. AC MILAN
item.description: TIME MACHINE: GENOA vs. AC MILAN Before the international break, it was an away match against Genoa. After the home Derby, the Rossoneri were back on the road for Matchday 11 of Serie A, heading to the Stadio L. Ferraris in Genoa's Marassi district, where on December 2, 2011 , AC Milan produced a convincing 2-0 win, inspired by the brilliance of Zlatan Ibrahimović and a strong all-around team performance. This was Allegri’s second season in charge, with the reigning champions still in excellent form. It was a wintery Friday night, and Van Bommel, Pato and Abbiati were all unavailable. It was not quite an injury crisis, but hardly ideal preparation for an important, tricky fixture. The Rossoneri were coming off a dominant 4-0 win over ChievoVerona at San Siro and had not lost since the start of October, when they were lost away against Juventus, their closest rivals in the title race. It was not a straightforward evening, with play briefly interrupted by crowd trouble inside the stadium. Ibrahimović and Nocerino proved to be a dangerous combination. Early on, the striker twice picked out the midfielder's runs, with Nocerino denied first by Rossi and then by Frey from close range. Robinho, Boateng and Nocerino all had further attempts without finding the target, before Ibra forced another save from Frey. Genoa grew into the game late in the first half: Amelia punched away a dangerous Veloso free kick, while Mesto failed to capitalize on a mix-up between Thiago Silva and Yepes in possession. The turning point came in the 56th minute . Robinho sent Ibrahimović through, and the Swede was brought down inside the box by former AC Milan defender Kaladze , who was shown a second yellow card and sent off. Penalty: Ibrahimović made no mistake, drilling his spot kick home to give AC Milan the lead. The closing stages were more comfortable, although Robinho somehow missed from point-blank range and Rossi went close with a backheel that drifted wide. Then, in the 79th minute , AC Milan put the result beyond doubt. Boateng delivered into the box and Nocerino arrived to finish calmly from close range. 2-0 to the Rossoneri , who would ultimately fall short in their bid to retain the title at the end of the 2011/12 season. item.title: What the Chiefs are saying about the Jets
item.description: (Photo by Al Bello/Getty Images) | Getty Images In Week 9, the Kansas City Chiefs will host the New York Jets near the midpoint of the 2026 regular season. The game at Arrowhead Stadium will feature a coaching matchup of second-year head coach Aaron Glenn and Chiefs head coach Andy Reid in his 28th season. At the podium Wednesday, Reid looked forward to the matchup with New York by describing the team Kansas City hasn’t faced in three years. The Chiefs won a road game on “Sunday Night Football” 23-20 in Week 4 of the 2023 season. “They’re very physical on both sides of the ball,” Reid said. “Scoring a lot of points on the offensive side, and their defense – they’ve got a lot of different looks that they’re going to present. Solid veteran players that do a nice job for them.” Glenn, a former NFL cornerback and Detroit Lions defensive coordinator, is organizing a unit that just allowed 38 points to the Las Vegas Raiders at home last week. However, this season, New York ranks 11th in total yards allowed per game (318) and allows the fifth-lowest rate of passing yards per game (194). “They’ve got some good veteran guys, whether it’s the safeties, the linebackers. You’re not going to have things that are botched up,” Reid shared. “They do a good job of making sure they can adjust to most things and do it accurately. Then they’ve got some guys on the front that are good football players, big guys. They’re good players. They’ve got some good speed on the outside.” Whether it’s linebacker Demario Davis or safety Minkah Fitzpatrick, the Jets made sure to bring in veterans to lead Glenn’s group this season. Chiefs offensive coordinator Eric Bieniemy pointed out the style of defense Glenn has instilled. “They play extremely hard,” Bieniemy pointed out. “They play fast and A.G.,obviously, they haven’t had the best of luck, but when you turn that tape on, they get your attention.” On the flip side, the Chiefs’ defense will face a hot Jets offense. They have scored 58 points over the last two weeks, and first-round rookies in wide receiver Omar Cooper Jr. and tight end Kenyon Sadiq have had big games around No. 1 wide receiver Garrett Wilson. With Wilson in concussion protocol this week, Chiefs defensive coordinator Steve Spagnuolo is still ready to defend downfield passes from veteran quarterback Geno Smith, who was once his quarterback when he was defensive coordinator and interim head coach of the New York Giants in 2017. Smith was also the quarterback for the Raiders when Kansas City pitched a 31-0 shutout with just four first downs allowed in Week 7 last year. “I’ve always had a lot of respect for Geno,” Spags said. “I’ve always had a great deal of respect for how smart he is and his rocket arm; he has a really strong arm. I put like three clips on yesterday of him from one side of the field throwing all the way [to the other], an out cut, deep to a number of different receivers. You know how talented and young they are, and they can all run that route. S

item.title: Forget the schedule, Jalen Brunson has another theory to explain the NBA injury crisis
item.description: Photo by Maddie Meyer/Getty Images Almost every team in the NBA has been hit by injuries this season. We are less than a month into the new campaign, and several big names have already been sidelined due to one issue or another. There are fears that the list could grow in the coming weeks and months. Many feel the schedule is the reason why, but Jalen Brunson has a different theory. Jalen Brunson says the NBA’s injury crisis could be down to ‘style of play’ It has been a real shame to see several fantastic players miss games due to injuries this season. From Anthony Edwards and Ja Morant to Paolo Banchero and Kawhi Leonard, many are currently sidelined, causing their respective teams to be significantly weaker. Several theories have been going around – from the gruelling schedule to a lack of preparation in pre-season practice sessions. But Jalen Brunson thinks it may actually be down to the style of play most coaches employ in the NBA in today’s game. When told that 16-20 per cent of the league is on the injury report, Brunson said on the Roommates Show : “I just feel like it’s a lot. “Is the schedule asking too much of the players? No! I mean, the schedule is the schedule. It’s been that way for – we’ve been playing 82 games for, I don’t know how many years – like decades. “But it’s obviously unfortunate things happen, but yeah, I don’t think it’s the scheduling part. I think maybe it’s like the style of play. We’re playing fast-paced basketball.” The intensity involved in almost every team sport in the world has gone up in recent years, and it is showing no signs of slowing down. That has definitely made games more interesting, but it has to be said that the physical burden on players has gone up as well. That increases the risk of injuries, which we are all seeing right now. item.title: Le Pagelle: Juventus vs. AZ Alkmaar
item.description: ALKMAAR, NETHERLANDS - NOVEMBER 5: Teun Koopmeiners of Juventus celebrates 0-1 goal with Randal Kolo Muani during the UEFA Europa League 2026/27 League Phase MD4 match between AZ Alkmaar and Juventus at AZ Stadion on November 5, 2026 in Alkmaar, Netherlands. (Photo by Daniele Badolato - Juventus FC/Juventus FC via Getty Images) | Juventus FC via Getty Images After Sunday’s victory against Napoli, my biggest hope was that Juventus would manage to keep some of that momentum going. It’s something that Juve have tended to struggle with over the last few years, and given the side’s current problems, they really couldn’t afford another Brigadoon game. (Side note: the more I’ve used that phrase this past week the more I like the image comparing Juve’s good games to the fleeting glimpses of the titular town in the musical. I don’t know if I officially coined it or not, but I’m claiming it, because why the hell not?) Thursday night’s Europa League match against AZ Alkmaar was a perfect test to see if that momentum could be kept up. AZ were a Pot 1 peer who hadn’t lost a European game at home in over three years — a total of 17 consecutive games coming in — and were just three spots behind Juve in the early League Phase table. It was also a homecoming for Teun Koopmeiners, who began his career at AZ and in this match would come face-to-face with his younger brother, Peer, who has been at the AFAS Stadion his entire career. Ironically, it was the elder Koopemeiners who got the scoring going with a neatly-taken goal in the 19th minute, followed very much against the run of play by Randal Kolo Muani 18 minutes later, produced largely by the Frenchman’s sheer force of will. But Juve were otherwise defending for long stretches against the home side. They missed a few chances to put the game away on the counter, but some shambolic defending with three minutes to go let AZ back in the game, and they very nearly squandered the lead entirely in stoppage time before being bailed out by the offside flag. But in the end they were able to hold just enough, and fly home to Turin with a 2-1 victory that vaulted them two spots to fifth in the table, and did indeed keep the momentum going forward as they head into the final game before the international break on Sunday. How did everyone do in this European matchup? Let’s take a closer look. GUGLIELMO VICARIO – 6. Played a good game overall, and made a pretty spectacular-looking save in stoppage time that ultimately didn’t count thanks to the offside flag — and thank goodness, because the game would’ve been tied otherwise. FEDERICO GATTI – 7. Had absolutely everything covered on defense until his odd withdrawal with 10 minutes to go (more on that later). He blocked three shots and made five interceptions, and the only reason this grade isn’t quite a bit higher still is that he flubbed a couple of counterattacks in the second half that could’ve put the game fully beyond reach. item.title: Central Falls, Classical head to the D-II boys soccer championship
item.description: JOHNSTON — Central Falls might have that magic. And Classical survived on grit. The Warriors were relentless for 80 minutes against Mt. Hope to continue their unexpected playoff run. A pair of goals from Daniel Rios Aceituno paced a 3-1 comeback in a Division II semifinal victory over the Huskies. Peter Breen closed out an unending night between Classical vs. Central in the second semifinal. The senior’s penalty kick lifted the Purple to a 0-0 (6-5) victory after eight penalty rounds on a breezy, Nov. 5 night at Johnston High School. Watch RI high school games on NFHS Network The eighth-ranked Huskies and third-ranked Purple advance to the championship at Rhode Island College on Sunday at 2:30 p.m. It’s the first title appearance for Central Falls, who are looking for their fifth championship overall, since it won a D-III crown in 2005. Classical advances to a title round for the first time since 2014 when it won a D-II championship. Central Falls won the season meeting against Classical, 4-1, in Providence in mid-September. “I told the team to keep our head up,” Rios Aceituno said. “Just keep it up and keep pushing. We've been working hard in practice every day.” “Right before I take that kick, I know what I'm going to do,” Breen said. “I feel calm. If the goalie guesses right, he guesses. But if he doesn't, that's awesome and we’re in the championship on Sunday.” Read on below for more on the D-II boys soccer semifinals. Central Falls strikes late The Warriors dominated possession in the first half against No. 4 Mt. Hope but trailed at halftime after a clinical set-piece header from Gavin Avila in the 17th minute. After turning back No. 1 Smithfield in penalty kicks in the quarterfinals, the upset kings still had plenty of fuel for the final 40 minutes. Kevin Ramos Pedroza provided the first cross that Rios Aceituno cleaned up with a header to the left corner with 27 minutes left. Second-chance opportunities were the Warriors’ best scoring looks against Mt. Hope keeper Cole Tavares. The senior stood on his head, but Central Falls broke through and was onto the championship from there. “We just told [each other] that we have to stay calm,” Oscar Veliz Catalan said. “It doesn't matter what the scoreboard is, we just have to keep our head up. It doesn't matter if it's 2-0. Just keep our head up.” Rios Aceituno provided the helper on the second goal with a tough angle to the short post before Veliz Catalan buried for the go-ahead goal with 8:03 left. Rios Aceituno added the insurance with five minutes left. “We came from last season, we came from not winning a game [in D-I],” Veliz Catalan said. “We came [into the year] with a good mindset, and I feel like this year really means a lot.” Classical wins in shootout Goalie Senai Zerit knew penalty kicks were coming early into the second half and everyone at Johnston knew they were in for a long night. item.title: Worcestershire trio aim to make more Cup magic
item.description: It's now 55 seasons since non-league Hereford United's 2-1 fourth-round replay win over top-flight Newcastle United entered English football folklore as arguably the greatest FA Cup shock of all time. Elsewhere in the Midlands, though, there have been many other upsets and moments of cup magic too. Telford United (in 1984) and Kidderminster Harriers (in 1994) both made it to the fifth round, and Worcestershire village side Alvechurch hold a record they will keep forever - unless the rules are changed again - after taking four replays to see off Oxford City in a qualifying round tie in 1971. Worcester City were involved in a record-breaking penalty shootout against Scunthorpe in 2014 - the same year they famously beat Coventry City. But, while the memory of that day at Hereford - Ronnie Radford et al - surpasses all other memories, across the Worcestershire border, it perhaps still irks a bit. Accompanied by fallen 1970s non-league stars Stafford Rangers, Worcestershire clubs make up three of the four non-EFL Midlands sides to have made it through to the first round proper - the Harriers plus seventh-tier duo Alvechurch and Worcester, who all face EFL clubs. How will they fare this time? Plymouth Argyle v Alvechurch 5th in League One v 6th in Southern League Premier Central (Tier 7) On paper, it looks a very tall order for Alvechurch. But not every non-league club has got an FA Cup pedigree like the Church's manager Kyle Storer. The former Bedworth United, Tamworth, Hinckley United, Atherstone Town, Nuneaton Town, Kiddy Harriers, Wrexham, Cheltenham Town, Solihull Moors, Nuneaton Borough, AFC Telford United, Kettering Town and Alvechurch player is not just a walking advert for Midlands non-league football, he has got plenty of FA Cup "previous" to be taken into consideration. "I've been very fortunate," Storer told BBC Midlands Today. "I got to the fourth round with Kiddy Harriers, when we played at Sunderland in front of 40,000. And that was having beaten Peterborough over two games with a team that had Joe Lolley, Marvin Johnson and Chey Dunkley." Kyle Storer (background) led Kiddy Harriers out for their 1-0 fourth-round defeat by Sunderland at the Stadium of Light [Shutterstock] "And, when I was at Tamworth, we won at Bournemouth [ Storer actually scored the winner] , then took Stoke to a replay. And we got Norwich at home in third round the following year." Dion Dublin and Darren Huckerby both netted twice in a 4-1 win but Storer had the last word by getting one back. "It was voted goal of the round too," he grins. "I've had some amazing FA Cup runs but let's hope we can go and create another day to remember. Let's hope we can cause some damage. "in terms of football prospects, it's a tough one. They're flying, aren't they? But, in financial terms, then it's amazing." item.title: KPop Demon Hunters on 4K Blu-ray costs less than a month of Netflix Premium
item.description: Buying the 4K Blu-ray disc version of KPop Demon Hunters was already going to be a wise idea for some people, especially those who primarily keep their $26.99 Netflix Premium subscription just to watch the hit animated flick in 4K. But at just $24.99 from Barnes and Noble instead of its original $49.95 price, it’s easier than ever to recommend. One important thing to note: it’s unavailable to ship from Barnes and Noble, but you can find a discounted copy at most retail stores, and the site makes it easy to reserve a copy online to pick up later. Amazon was matching the price earlier today, but is currently offering a slightly less tempting deal. KPop Demon Hunters (4K Blu-ray) Where to Buy: $49.95 $37.99 at Amazon $49.95 $24.99 at Barnes & Noble (in-store pickup) The Criterion Collection version of the film recently launched, and comes with a bunch of extras in a gorgeous set. In addition to the 4K digital master, complete with Dolby Vision HDR and Dolby Atmos sound, you also get two standard 1080p Blu-rays, one containing the film, and the other packed with special features (a full feature-length animatic, a making-of documentary, lyric videos, and more). It includes physical goodies, too, like collectible postcards, as well as an essay by Polygon alum Karen Han. Kpop Demon Hunters was on my list of physical movies to buy, and this deal just turned it into a must-buy ahead of the holiday season.

item.title: DMZ key and locations in Modern Warfare 4

item.title: Meet Nigeria’s Tracy Richards among Miss Globe 2026 Top 11
item.description: By Sekinat Osundiji Nigeria’s representative at the Miss Globe 2026, Tracy Richards, has finished among the top 11 finalists at the international beauty pageant held in Phuket, Thailand. Richards also won the Head-to-Head Challenge and secured a place in the top 25 of the talent competition at the 23rd edition of the pageant, which concluded on Friday, November 6, 2026. Vietnam’s Nguyen Thu Thao emerged as the winner, while Thailand’s Suttida Iadpoo and Ukraine’s Mariia Zheliaskova finished as first and second runners-up, respectively. Richards hails from Ohaji/Egbema Local Government Area of Imo State. She is a high-fashion model and entrepreneur who co-owns a modelling agency. Beyond modelling, she is also involved in initiatives aimed at expanding opportunities for children in underserved communities through her advocacy project, Open Horizons. The initiative focuses on providing children in underserved communities in Lagos with access to mentorship, education and experiential learning through after-school programmes and educational outings. According to the project, the initiative is founded on the belief that exposing children to new experiences and opportunities can help shape their aspirations and future. Reacting to her performance, Richards’ team, in a post on Instagram on Friday, celebrated her top 11 finish and appreciated Nigerians who supported her throughout the competition. “From the moment she stepped onto the international stage in Phuket, Thailand, Tracy carried the Nigerian spirit, grace and determination with pride. What a journey, what a beautiful representation, and what an achievement to celebrate!” the team said. Thanking supporters who voted and encouraged the contestant, the team added, “To everyone who voted, supported, encouraged and stood behind her throughout this journey, THANK YOU.” It further described her performance as a source of national pride, saying, “Tracy, you made Nigeria proud. Your journey does not end here, and your light will continue to shine.” Her top 11 finish, victory in the Head-to-Head Challenge and placement among the top 25 in the talent competition marked a notable outing for Nigeria at the international pageant. Vanguard News The post Meet Nigeria’s Tracy Richards among Miss Globe 2026 Top 11 appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: DoJ's 'Super Intelligence Task Force' up and running
item.description: The US Department of Justice (DoJ) says its Super Intelligence Task Force (SINTF) is now up and running, after president Donald Trump ordered the move in a memo last month. Headed up by director of national intelligence Jay Clayton, as well as associate attorney general Stanley Woodward and associate deputy attorney general Stephen Weiss, SINTF's responsibility is to protect the US's lead in artificial intelligence development. Thursday's announcement, which was littered with the " super intelligence " Trumpism, said the task force will ensure the US's SI/AI leadership remains uncompromised by foreign AI "abuse," including by state and state-backed groups, criminal enterprises, individuals, or corporate entities. Per Trump's October 13 memo [PDF], SITF will take "affirmative measures, as appropriate," to ensure the US stays ahead in AI development. It did not elaborate on what this nebulous phrase meant, but it can be reasonably assumed this means a breadth of proactive steps. The memo also stated that the task force will organize the DoJ's criminal and civil lawsuits involving AI, recommend enforcement priorities concerning public safety and AI misuse, develop prosecution guidance for unlawful AI conduct, and feed into legislative proposals to prevent "burdensome regulation." Addressing a Wall Street Journal tech conference this week, Pentagon CTO and SITF vice chair Emil Michael said the team would release details about its AI regulatory landscape later this month. The task force will also shoulder various cross-departmental responsibilities, such as "deconflicting investigations, cases, and other matters" among departments and the offices of US attorneys. According to quotes from senior officials, chief among the concerns facing ordinary US citizens are AI attacks that target individuals, as well as those that aim to disrupt critical infrastructure and other national security interests. "The creation of the DOJ-SITF marks an important moment for the Department to help advance SI technologies and, at the same time, protect American innovation," said Weiss. "The Department also has a responsibility to utilize law enforcement tools at our disposal to deter improper use of SI, harden regular reporting on SI risk and response, and ensure companies exercise vigorous internal controls so that SI technology behaves as intended. The Department is committed to protecting all Americans and our business interests." Trump compelled the US to start using the term "super intelligence" in September, claiming "artificial intelligence," the widely used and original term coined in the mid-1950s, was a better descriptor for the technology's capabilities. The US government's dedicated website for SI states that "America is in a race for Super Intelligence. We intend to win it." It also highlights a number of initiatives the government has taken to promote its AI supremacy, including legal guidance to streamline federal approvals, leading to more data centers being

item.title: Rule to Allow Crypto in 401(k)s Arrives at White House for Final Review
item.description: Bitcoin Magazine Rule to Allow Crypto in 401(k)s Arrives at White House for Final Review A final DOL rule that would ease alternative assets such as private equity, real estate and cryptocurrency into 401(k) retirement plans arrived at the White House on Thursday for review, Bloomberg Law reported , a procedural step that usually precedes public release. The Office of Information and Regulatory Affairs logged the package on Nov. 5 under the title “Fiduciary Duties In Selecting Designated Investment Alternatives,” RIN 1210-AC38. The filing lists the DOL’s Employee Benefits Security Administration as the authoring office, marks the stage as a final rule, flags it as economically significant and notes that there is no legal deadline for completion. The DOL unveiled the proposal on March 30. In that draft, plan fiduciaries who follow a documented process when adding private assets to a 401(k) menu would get a legal safe harbor under the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974. The six factors named in the proposal are performance, fees, liquidity, valuation, performance benchmarks and complexity. Satisfying them does not force plans to offer crypto. It lowers the litigation risk for employers that decide they want to. JUST IN: The White House is now reviewing a new rule which will allow Americans to invest in crypto through their 401(k) retirement plans pic.twitter.com/uXGGIXEzdC — Bitcoin Magazine (@BitcoinMagazine) November 6, 2026 What the DOL safe harbor covers President Donald Trump’s Aug. 7, 2025, executive order, “Democratizing Access to Alternative Assets for 401(k) Investors,” directed the Labor secretary to reexamine ERISA guidance and, where appropriate, propose rules with “appropriately calibrated safe harbors.” The order defined alternative assets to include private-market equity and debt, real estate, holdings in actively managed vehicles that invest in digital assets, commodities, infrastructure and lifetime-income strategies. The March proposal implements that order. A DOL fact sheet said prudence under ERISA is process-based and that fiduciaries retain discretion to select any designated investment alternative if they follow the outlined review. Deputy Labor Secretary Keith Sonderling cast the approach as neutral: “The department’s days of picking winners and losers are over.” That stance reverses a prior chill. In May 2025 the DOL rescinded its March 2022 compliance release that told fiduciaries to use “extreme care” before putting cryptocurrency on a 401(k) menu. The department said that phrase was not found in ERISA and restored a context-specific standard. Later, it was reported that Sens. Bernie Sanders and Elizabeth Warren pressed the DOL to abandon the crypto-friendly path. House Republicans have separately pushed to codify Trump’s crypto order in statute. item.title: Four dead, 14 critically ill after suspected herbal poisoning in Benue
item.description: By Peter Duru, Makurdi At least four persons have reportedly died, while 14 others are receiving treatment in hospital after consuming a suspected poisonous herbal mixture purchased in Oju township, headquarters of Oju Local Government Area of Benue State. The incident reportedly followed the sale of herbal preparations by three men identified as Alhaji Mai Magamani, Mohamed and Musa Kolo to residents of the Igede community during the Ihiejwo market day in Oju last weekend. An eyewitness said the incident came to light on Monday, November 2, 2026, after several residents who had purchased and consumed the herbal preparations began experiencing similar symptoms. According to the eyewitness, the first victim reportedly died on Tuesday morning, while the second died in the early hours of Wednesday. Two others subsequently died on November 4. The source added that more than 14 other persons were receiving treatment, with several reportedly in critical condition. The three men allegedly involved in selling the herbal preparations were reportedly apprehended by the Igede Youth Council in collaboration with the Oju Local Government Area Township Youth leadership and handed over to the police. The eyewitness said the Oju Divisional Police Headquarters had transferred the case to the Benue State Police Command for further investigation. Speaking during the handover of the suspects, President of the Igede Youth Council, Comrade John-Frank Ozzidi, called on the Benue State Government to ensure a thorough investigation and that anyone found culpable was brought to justice. Ozzidi said members of the community had resisted taking the law into their own hands, choosing instead to allow the police and other relevant authorities to handle the matter. He urged political officeholders from the area to monitor the investigation to ensure that the circumstances surrounding the deaths were established and justice served. Contacted, Chairman of Oju Local Government Council, Mr Jackson Ominyi, confirmed the incident but said he had yet to establish the exact number of fatalities. He said three deaths had been reported to him as of the previous day, while other affected persons were receiving treatment at the General Hospital, Oju. “My people are working on that. My security secretary, secretary and the security adviser are on it. “The others are in the General Hospital, Oju. My health department is also taking care of them. I have tried to calm the situation down. The person selling the herbs has been arrested and sent to Makurdi three days back,” he said. Efforts to reach the Police Public Relations Officer, DSP Peter Aondongu, for comments were unsuccessful, as he did not respond to enquiries as of the time of filing this report. The post Four dead, 14 critically ill after suspected herbal poisoning in Benue appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: FG’s ₦50,000: Step-by-step guide on how MTN users can access funds
item.description: MTN subscribers selected for the Federal Government’s ₦50,000 monthly relief programme can check their eligibility and access the financial support through the MoMo Payment Service Bank (PSB) USSD code. The National Emergency Relief and Stabilisation Intervention (NERSI) is designed to provide financial assistance to vulnerable Nigerian households to help them meet essential needs amid rising living costs. According to the official NERSI portal, beneficiaries are selected using verified national identity records and the National Social Register. Selected beneficiaries are contacted through approved payment providers, including MoMo PSB, ALAT by Wema Bank, NairaGram, OPay and Moniepoint. For eligible MTN subscribers assigned to MoMo PSB, the designated USSD code is * 671 *0#. How MTN subscribers can check eligibility and access the ₦50,000 support 1. Dial the USSD code: MTN subscribers can dial 671 0# using their registered phone numbers and follow the prompts to check their eligibility or payment status. 2. Accept the offer: Subscribers who receive an official notification confirming their selection should follow the instructions provided to give consent and accept the support. 3. Respond to MoMo notifications: Beneficiaries who receive a genuine MoMo notification requesting consent should follow the prompts and select the appropriate option to authorise the payment. 4. Open a MoMo account: Selected beneficiaries without an existing MoMo wallet can dial *671# or download the official MoMo NG app to register. 5. Access the funds: Once the ₦50,000 is credited, beneficiaries can withdraw or transfer the money through the MoMo application, USSD service or an authorised MoMo agent. They can also transfer the funds to their bank accounts. The Federal Government has explained that beneficiaries will receive SMS notifications from their assigned payment providers requesting consent before the money is transferred to their mobile wallets. In an October 30 statement announcing the commencement of the intervention, the Minister of Humanitarian Affairs and Poverty Reduction, Dr Bernard Doro, said eligible beneficiaries would receive ₦50,000 monthly to support their essential needs. “Beneficiaries will receive an SMS from one of these providers asking for their consent. This message is genuine. Once consent is given, payment is made directly to the beneficiary’s account/mobile wallet,” Doro stated. The minister also clarified that beneficiaries do not need to apply, pay any fee or register through an agent to receive the support. The ministry has warned Nigerians against sharing their personal identification numbers (PINs) and Bank Verification Numbers (BVNs) with unauthorised individuals. Meanwhile, the NERSI portal states that the intervention is free and that selected beneficiaries are being contacted in batches. item.title: Hera probe gets 1st good luck at asteroid system clobbered by NASA's DART mission | Space photo of the day for Nov. 6, 2026
item.description: null The Didymos binary asteroid system, as seen by Europe's Hera probe. The main asteroid, Didymos, dominates the frame while just a sliver of its "moonlet," Dimorphos, is visible beneath it. ESA released this image on Nov. 5, 2026. (Image credit: ESA) The European Space Agency 's (ESA) Hera spacecraft has gotten its first close-up look at the Didymos binary asteroid system. If that system sounds familiar, it's because it made headlines in September 2022 when NASA's DART (Double Asteroid Redirection Test) spacecraft smashed into it. The aim of the DART mission was to test whether an impact could divert an asteroid away from a collision course with Earth. The purpose of Hera is to follow up on DART by making up-close observations of the Didymos system. "The first thing we said was, 'Wow,'" Hera Principal Investigator Patrick Michel said in a statement about the image, which ESA released on Thursday (Nov. 5). "This is the other side of Didymos from the one that DART’s camera showed us shortly before impact, so this feels like looking at a whole new world." What is it? The Didymos system consists of the eponymous 2,560-foot-wide (780 meters) space rock and its "moonlet" Dimorphos, which is about 530 feet (160 m) in diameter. The DART mission impacted Dimorphos on Sept. 26, 2022, with the aim of causing a change in the orbital period of the moonlet. And it worked: Before the impact, Dimorphos completed one lap around Didymos in around 11 hours and 55 minutes. The DART collision reduced the length of this period by around 33 minutes. The change is a result of the fact that Dimporphos is now traveling at around 2.7 millimeters per second more slowly than it did before the collision. The newly released photo shows Didymos in detail. Just a sliver of Dimorphos is visible, below and slightly to the left of the main asteroid. Why is it incredible? The changes caused by DART were small. But in a real Earth-threatening scenario, even such a tiny shift could help divert an asteroid on a collision course — as long as scientists get enough advance warning of its approach. Hera's observations should help reveal what other changes have occurred on and around Didymos. Scientists are already seeing that, while Didymos has the same central ridge along its equator as before the impact, many changes have occurred. This includes the creation of multiple boulders, craters, and patterns of grooves or ridges. "Since we expect a lot of impact-ejected material to have made it across the approximately 1 kilometer [0.62 miles] of space from Dimorphos to Didymos, it may be that some of these characteristics originate from this transport of material, and we have exciting work ahead of us to sort it out," said Michael Kueppers, ESA’s Hera mission scientist. "We look forward to seeing much more of both bodies and systemically mapping all the changes we identify." Stay tuned to Space.com for more Hera findings from Didymos.

item.title: Binance Hackers Swap About $50 Million of Stolen XRP Mostly Into Bitcoin, Elliptic Says
item.description: Bitcoin Magazine Binance Hackers Swap About $50 Million of Stolen XRP Mostly Into Bitcoin, Elliptic Says Hackers tied to the record Binance theft have begun converting a large slice of the stolen XRP into bitcoin, blockchain analytics firm Elliptic said in an update dated through Friday, with about 42 million XRP — roughly $50 million — already swapped, mostly through THORChain. Converted bitcoin from other stolen assets nearly doubled overnight to about 1,650 BTC, worth some $124 million, Elliptic wrote . Most of that jump came from the XRP route. About 192 million XRP, roughly $226 million, remained unswapped in addresses linked to the Binance theft. The XRP was part of the Oct. 29 drain that Binance later put at $6.34 billion. Between 20:05 and 20:09 UTC that day, five hot wallets sent 233.46 million XRP to an attacker address. The FBI has attributed the campaign to North Korea’s TraderTraitor group. Binance has reopened withdrawals in stages and said it has frozen or intercepted about $2.85 billion while covering customer losses from its own funds. How the XRP started moving The stolen XRP sat quiet at first. Early on Nov. 2, between 02:12 and 04:00 UTC, all about 233 million XRP moved into six new addresses, where it stayed until Nov. 5, Elliptic said . From the afternoon of Nov. 5, two of those six addresses began sending XRP on to dozens of new accounts that swapped it, mostly through THORChain into bitcoin. A small amount of ether also went through THORChain into bitcoin that evening. The main bitcoin and ether holdings from the theft — the largest pools — have still not moved, Elliptic said. That pattern matches what the firm saw after the Bybit hack: turn freezable and mid-liquidity tokens into bitcoin first, then attempt cash-out later through OTC brokers. The broader laundering trail is already vast. Since the Binance theft, Elliptic has counted more than 20,000 wallets on 16 blockchains, at least 36 services and at least 65,000 transactions — roughly one new wallet every 30 seconds and one transaction every 10 seconds. About $3.11 billion remains in addresses linked to the Binance theft, mostly as ether and bitcoin. A negligible amount has likely been cashed out so far. Why XRP and bitcoin matter here Issuers can freeze many stablecoins. They cannot freeze XRP the same way, and they cannot freeze bitcoin. After Tether and Circle locked down large stablecoin tranches on Oct. 29, the attacker prioritized assets that sit outside that kill switch. Swapping XRP into bitcoin continues that logic: bitcoin is harder to claw back once it is fragmented across fresh addresses. All of the stolen SOL, about $87 million at Elliptic’s prices, has already been swapped, bridged or mixed, with much of it ending as bitcoin. Most early Tron laundering — about $220 million in TRX — has also run, a flow Bitcoin Magazine noted when covering the quiet shutdown of the T3 Financial Crime Unit before the hack. item.description: —Initiative promotes cheaper energy, attracts private investment — Perm Sec – –Says 10 JAC vehicles, Villa shuttle buses already CNG-hybrid By Johnbosco Agbakwuru ABUJA–The Federal Government has renewed its drive to promote the adoption of Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) with the reopening of a former petrol filling station at the State House, Abuja, now converted into a CNG refuelling facility. Plans are also underway to extend vehicle conversion services to interested government personnel. The Permanent Secretary, State House, Temitope Fashedemi, stated that the initiative underscored the administration’s resolve to lead by example in promoting cost-effective and cleaner energy alternatives, while encouraging private-sector participation in the development of the country’s gas infrastructure. Speaking at the inauguration of the facility in Karu, Abuja, Fashedemi disclosed that the project was executed through a partnership between the State House, the Presidential Initiative on Compressed Natural Gas and Electric Vehicles (Pi-CNG & EV), and Rollin Energy Limited, with no expenditure incurred by the State House for its rehabilitation. He explained that the Federal Government deliberately made the abandoned facility available for conversion to demonstrate the viability of the presidential initiative and encourage private investors to take advantage of emerging opportunities in the CNG market. He further explained the initiative is also aimed at addressing concerns over the limited availability of CNG refuelling stations, which has continued to constrain wider adoption of the alternative fuel. Fashedemi said government’s responsibility was to create an enabling environment for private-sector participation rather than take over the business of establishing and operating commercial refuelling facilities. He urged business operators and prospective investors to partner with Pi-CNG to establish more stations and vehicle conversion centres across the country. “All the filling stations you see around, are they owned by government? No. They are owned by people and business operators. The earlier existing and prospective business people recognise this as an opportunity and partner with Pi-CNG to establish these facilities, the better,” he said. The Permanent Secretary disclosed that the State House had already commenced the integration of CNG technology into its vehicle fleet, with about 10 recently acquired JAC vehicles being hybrid models, alongside some shuttle buses operating within the Presidential Villa. He said the government was taking further steps to encourage interested State House personnel to convert eligible personal vehicles to CNG-hybrid systems in the coming weeks. “We are demonstrating that we are walking the talk of Mr President. In the next few weeks, a number of our staff will be bringing their vehicles here for conversion, subject to the eligibility of the vehicles,” he said. item.description: Former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar has rejected the latest court ruling affecting the African Democratic Congress (ADC), insisting that he will remain in the race for the 2027 presidential election. Atiku, in a statement issued on Friday, said the judgment nullifying the David Mark-led leadership of the party and his presidential nomination should not be mistaken for the will of Nigerians. “Let no one mistake the latest court ruling for the will of the Nigerian people. No manipulation, conjecture or concoction can erase our place in this contest, silence our campaign or deny Nigerians the right to choose their future,” he said. “We are on the ballot, and the people must be allowed to decide.” The former vice-president accused President Bola Tinubu’s administration of deploying political pressure, court manoeuvres and other tactics to weaken opposition parties ahead of the election. He alleged that those in power were attempting to compromise the voters’ register through “AI-generated photographs, false names and fictitious identities”. Atiku said such actions were aimed at making genuine political competition difficult and pushing Nigeria towards a one-party state. He also challenged the ruling party to defend its record before voters rather than rely on its political strength. “Those who boast of having thirty-two governors and claim to have bought, pressured or coerced leaders from other parties into their fold should have no reason to fear a free and fair contest,” he said. Atiku criticised the Tinubu administration over the removal of fuel subsidy, the depreciation of the naira, rising food prices and worsening insecurity, arguing that the government had failed to ease the hardship facing Nigerians. He said businesses had shut down, young people were leaving the country in search of opportunities, while banditry and kidnapping continued to threaten communities. “Look around you. Market stalls stand empty. Feeding your family has become a daily struggle. Fuel prices keep rising, and silent pain fills homes across the country,” he said. Atiku urged his supporters not to lose hope, insisting that he would not withdraw from the presidential contest despite the legal challenge. “Let me be clear to every Nigerian who has stood with us: I am in this race. I am not going anywhere. We will be on the ballot,” he said. “No threat, blackmail or court manoeuvre will make me abandon you or the cause we share.” He vowed that the opposition would resist attempts to turn Nigeria into a one-party state and called on the ruling party to face its opponents in a free, fair and credible election. “If those in power believe in their numbers and their record, let us meet at the polls in a free, fair and credible contest,” Atiku said. He added that his campaign would continue to focus on the cost of living and the need to make life more affordable for Nigerians. “Let me say this plainly: Bola cannot use the courts to escape the judgment of Nigerians at the ballot b

item.title: FinTribe Finance Fair 2026: Empowers Over 10,000 Women to Build Wealth and Financial Independence
item.description: Over 10,000 women gathered at the Landmark Event Centre, Victoria Island, Lagos, on October 31, 2026, for the fourth edition of FinTribe Finance Fair , a growing movement dedicated to helping African women move from financial awareness to wealth creation and ownership. Themed I CAN and powered by returning lead sponsor Sycamore, the event brought together financial experts, business leaders, entrepreneurs and influential personalities, including Funke Akindele , Omoni Oboli , BamBam , Sola Adesakin and Olufemi Shobanjo , for a day of practical financial education, inspiring conversations and meaningful opportunities. For FinTribe founder Jennifer Awirigwe , popularly known as Financial Jennifer, the fair represents a bigger mission: helping women gain the confidence and resources to take charge of their financial futures. “Financial education is important, but knowledge must eventually become action. We want women to leave Finance Fair knowing that they can save, invest, grow their income, build businesses and take ownership of their financial future,” she shared ahead of the event. Beyond Finance Fair, FinTribe is building a community where women learn about money and put that knowledge into practice . With a presence across 43 countries, the organisation has reached over 20,000 women through financial education, supported more than 5,000 women with capital market training and helped members collectively save and invest millions of dollars. Through its Wealth Builders Academy, savings and investment community, real estate initiatives and recently launched FinTribe App, the organisation continues to create opportunities for women to build healthier financial habits, develop investment confidence and work towards long-term financial independence. At the fair, award-winning filmmaker Omoni Oboli encouraged women to pursue their ambitions without neglecting their wellbeing, reminding them to take things one step at a time, prioritise rest and ask for help when needed. During the Financial Clinic, Sola Adesakin challenged women to become more intentional about their finances, emphasising the importance of earning, budgeting and turning income into real assets. She also introduced the four forces of money: Earnings, Expenses, Engines and Encumbrances. Olufemi Shobanjo of NGX Regulation Limited shared insights into capital market participation, while actress BamBam, marketing strategist and Woof Studios founder Adetutu Laditan, and Mercy Agbeti, popularly known as Christian Money Woman, contributed to conversations about building value, navigating opportunities and growing with purpose. One of the most memorable moments came during Funke Akindele’s session when a medical doctor and founder of Raffia Fashion Africa presented the actress with a pair of handcrafted raffia earrings . Funke immediately wore them, danced, invited the entrepreneur onto the stage, embraced her, prayed for her and publicly endorsed her business. The entrepreneur later shared on

item.title: Alaafin, number one ruler in Yorubaland – Oba Owoade
item.description: The Alaafin of Oyo, Oba Abimbola Akeem Owoade I, has declared that he is the number one traditional ruler in Yorubaland, citing the historical significance and contributions of the old Oyo Empire to Yoruba civilisation. The monarch made the assertion during an interview on Edmund Obilo’s channel, where he spoke on Yoruba unity, the historical position of the Alaafin and his plans for the development of Oyo. Asked whether the Alaafin was the supreme king in Yorubaland, Oba Owoade answered in the affirmative, maintaining that history supported the position. “Historically, yes. If you want to go by history and the contribution of Oyo to Yoruba civilisation, then I would say that the Alaafin is number one,” he said. He, however, dismissed suggestions that he was in competition with other prominent Yoruba monarchs, particularly the Ooni of Ife, over traditional supremacy. “I don’t fight for supremacy or whatever with anybody,” he said. On his commitment to the Yoruba race, the monarch said he regularly prayed for the progress of the people, stressing that the success of Oyo would bring honour to the entire Yoruba race. “I believe that when Oyo succeeds, the Yoruba in their entirety get honoured. That’s my belief,” he said. Speaking on the development of Oyo, Oba Owoade expressed optimism about ongoing infrastructure projects, particularly the proposed circular road and its planned dualisation. He said the project, which would connect areas including Infinity and Sabo, would improve the city’s appearance and contribute to its development. The Alaafin also discussed the forthcoming Oyo Empire Day, describing it as a three-day celebration expected to attract about 40,000 people. He explained that the event was designed to bring together communities and people historically connected to the old Oyo Empire, irrespective of their present locations. According to him, the celebration would provide an opportunity to reconnect with their roots, preserve Yoruba culture and deliberate on the future of coming generations. Explaining why the event was named Oyo Empire Day rather than Oyo Day, the monarch said the empire had a wider historical reach beyond the present-day Oyo community. “The Oyo Empire comprises a number of people and cities, not just one. That’s why we are trying to make sure that we come together, reconnect to our roots, preserve our culture, deliberate on how to move forward and make a better future for our children together,” he said. Oba Owoade further disclosed that a Hall of Fame would be established as part of the celebration to recognise individuals and communities that had made significant contributions to Yoruba civilisation, Oyo Empire history, culture and heritage. He added that attendance would not be restricted to people with ancestral links to Oyo, noting that anyone interested in Yoruba culture was welcome. “Everybody is invited. If you are a lover of culture, you love the way Oyo is doing its things, you are part of it. We are not e
